sqlFunctionBodies.canonicalSql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.p02_resolve_persisted_authority_v3(session_token_hash text,resource_type text,resource_id text,operation_key text,required_permission text,expected_context_revision text,expected_target_revision bigint) RETURNS TABLE(outcome text,reason text,actor_id text,scope_kind text,dealer_ids text[],location_ids text[],resource_revision bigint,resolver_id text,grant_provenance jsonb) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE reg public.f1_p02_resolver_registry%ROWTYPE;uid text;target_scope text;target_dealers text[];target_locations text[];target_context text;target_revision bigint;provenance jsonb;has_global boolean;BEGIN SELECT * INTO reg FROM public.f1_p02_resolver_registry WHERE "resourceType"=resource_type AND "operationKey"=operation_key AND "permissionKey"=required_permission;IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT 'denied','unknown_tuple',NULL::text,NULL::text,NULL::text[],NULL::text[],NULL::bigint,NULL::text,NULL::jsonb;RETURN;END IF;SELECT s."userId" INTO uid FROM public.refresh_sessions s JOIN public.users u ON u.id=s."userId" WHERE s."tokenHash"=session_token_hash AND s."revokedAt" IS NULL AND s."expiresAt">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND u.status='active' AND u.kind='admin';IF uid IS NULL THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT 'denied','session_denied',NULL::text,NULL::text,NULL::text[],NULL::text[],NULL::bigint,reg."resolverId",NULL::jsonb;RETURN;END IF;CASE resource_type WHEN 'p08_import' THEN SELECT "authorizationScopeKind","dealerIdsSnapshot","locationIdsSnapshot","contextRevision",version::bigint INTO target_scope,target_dealers,target_locations,target_context,target_revision FROM public.dashboard_import_batch WHERE id::text=resource_id;WHEN 'p08_export' THEN SELECT "authorizationScopeKind","dealerIdsSnapshot","locationIdsSnapshot","contextRevision",version::bigint INTO target_scope,target_dealers,target_locations,target_context,target_revision FROM public.dashboard_export_request WHERE id::text=resource_id;WHEN 'p09_config' THEN SELECT "authorizationScopeKind","dealerIdsSnapshot","locationIdsSnapshot","contextRevision",generation INTO target_scope,target_dealers,target_locations,target_context,target_revision FROM public.runtime_config_version WHERE id::text=resource_id;WHEN 'p09_flag' THEN SELECT "authorizationScopeKind","dealerIdsSnapshot","locationIdsSnapshot","contextRevision",generation INTO target_scope,target_dealers,target_locations,target_context,target_revision FROM public.feature_flag_version WHERE id::text=resource_id;WHEN 'p10_analytics_ingestion' THEN SELECT "authorizationScopeKind","dealerIdsSnapshot","locationIdsSnapshot","contextRevision",version::bigint INTO target_scope,target_dealers,target_locations,target_context,target_revision FROM public.foundation_sample WHERE id::text=resource_id;ELSE target_scope:='global';target_dealers:=ARRAY[]::text[];target_locations:=ARRAY[]::text[];target_context:=expected_context_revision;target_revision:=expected_target_revision;END CASE;IF target_scope IS NULL THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT 'not_found','resource_not_found',uid,NULL::text,NULL::text[],NULL::text[],NULL::bigint,reg."resolverId",NULL::jsonb;RETURN;END IF;WITH direct_grants AS (SELECT 'direct_user_role' source_kind,ur.id user_role_id,NULL::text membership_id,NULL::integer membership_revision,r.id role_id,r.key role_key,rp.id role_permission_id,p.id permission_id,p.key permission_key,NULL::text dealer_id,NULL::text location_id FROM public.user_roles ur JOIN public.roles r ON r.id=ur."roleId" JOIN public.role_permissions rp ON rp."roleId"=r.id JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id=rp."permissionId" WHERE ur."userId"=uid AND p.key=required_permission AND r.key<>'dealer_admin'),membership_grants AS (SELECT 'dealer_membership_role',NULL::text,m.id,m.revision,r.id,r.key,rp.id,p.id,p.key,m."dealerId",dl.id FROM public.dealer_memberships m JOIN public.dealers d ON d.id=m."dealerId" AND d.status='active' JOIN public.dealer_membership_roles mr ON mr."membershipId"=m.id JOIN public.roles r ON r.id=mr."roleId" JOIN public.role_permissions rp ON rp."roleId"=r.id JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id=rp."permissionId" AND p.key=required_permission LEFT JOIN public.dealer_membership_locations ml ON ml."membershipId"=m.id AND ml."dealerId"=m."dealerId" LEFT JOIN public.dealer_locations dl ON dl.id=ml."dealerLocationId" AND dl."dealerId"=ml."dealerId" AND dl.status='active' WHERE m."userId"=uid AND m.status='active' AND m."revokedAt" IS NULL AND m."validFrom"<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (m."expiresAt" IS NULL OR m."expiresAt">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND r.key='dealer_admin'),g AS (SELECT * FROM direct_grants UNION ALL SELECT * FROM membership_grants) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM g WHERE source_kind='direct_user_role'),COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g) ORDER BY source_kind,membership_id,user_role_id,role_id,dealer_id,location_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO has_global,provenance FROM g;IF provenance='[]'::jsonb THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT 'denied','permission_denied',uid,NULL::text,NULL::text[],NULL::text[],target_revision,reg."resolverId",provenance;RETURN;END IF;IF NOT has_global AND ((target_scope='global') OR (target_scope='dealer' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(target_dealers) d WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_to_recordset(provenance) x(source_kind text,dealer_id text,location_id text) WHERE x.dealer_id=d))) OR (target_scope='location' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.dealer_locations dl WHERE dl.id=ANY(target_locations) AND dl."dealerId"=ANY(target_dealers) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_to_recordset(provenance) x(source_kind text,dealer_id text,location_id text) WHERE x.dealer_id=dl."dealerId" AND (x.location_id IS NULL OR x.location_id=dl.id))))) THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT 'denied','scope_denied',uid,target_scope,target_dealers,target_locations,target_revision,reg."resolverId",provenance;RETURN;END IF;IF expected_context_revision IS NULL OR expected_target_revision IS NULL OR target_context IS DISTINCT FROM expected_context_revision OR target_revision IS DISTINCT FROM expected_target_revision THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT 'stale','context_or_target_revision_changed',uid,target_scope,target_dealers,target_locations,target_revision,reg."resolverId",provenance;RETURN;END IF;RETURN QUERY SELECT 'authorized','authorized',uid,target_scope,target_dealers,target_locations,target_revision,reg."resolverId",provenance;END $fn$;

sqlFunctionBodies.canonicalSql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.p04_write_forward_audit_v4(session_token_hash text, resource_type text, resource_id text, operation_key text, required_permission text, expected_context_revision text, expected_target_revision bigint, audit_action text, audit_resource_type text, audit_result text, audit_reason text, request_id text, safe_metadata jsonb) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE a record; v_id uuid:=gen_random_uuid(); v_now timestamptz:=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP; BEGIN SELECT * INTO a FROM public.p02_resolve_persisted_authority_v3(session_token_hash,resource_type,resource_id,operation_key,required_permission,expected_context_revision,expected_target_revision); IF a.outcome<>'authorized' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'P04_AUTHORITY_%',upper(a.outcome) USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; INSERT INTO public.audit_events("id","eventVersion","occurredAt","actorType","actorId","actorDisplayClass","effectiveRoles","permissionGrants","authorizationScopeKind","dealerIds","locationIds","contextRevision","authorizationContractVersion","action","resourceType","resourceId","result","reason","requestId","source","metadata","sensitive","retentionClass","retentionPolicyVersion","expiresAt","createdAt") VALUES(v_id,'audit-event.v1',v_now,'admin_user',a.actor_id,'staff','[]'::jsonb,jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('permissionKey',required_permission,'scopeKind',a.scope_kind,'dealerIds',a.dealer_ids,'locationIds',a.location_ids)),a.scope_kind,to_jsonb(a.dealer_ids),to_jsonb(a.location_ids),'f1-v15-clarification','dashboard-authorization.v1',audit_action,audit_resource_type,resource_id,audit_result,audit_reason,request_id,'dashboard_api',COALESCE(safe_metadata,'{}'::jsonb),false,'default','audit-retention.v1',v_now+interval '730 days',v_now); RETURN v_id; END $fn$;

integer,observed_at timestamptz,nonce_hash text) RETURNS TABLE(instance_id_out text,generation_out bigint,lifecycle_version_out integer) LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE current_row public.worker_heartbeats%ROWTYPE;next_generation bigint;canonical_types text[]:=ARRAY['analytics.release.seal','analytics.source.cleanup'];BEGIN IF registry_version<>'async-job-registry.v2' OR unnest(supported_job_types)x)<>canonical_types OR declared_capacity<0 OR declared_capacity>1024 OR observed_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+interval '5 seconds' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'P09_WORKER_V2_INVALID';END IF;SELECT * INTO current_row FROM public.worker_heartbeats WHERE key=instance_id FOR UPDATE;next_generation:=COALESCE(current_row."generation",0)+1;INSERT INTO public.worker_heartbeats(key,"instanceId","lastStartedAt","lifecycleState","claimEnabled","declaredCapacity","effectiveCapacity","supportedJobTypes","registryVersion","registryFingerprint","generation","lifecycleVersion","startedObservedAt","heartbeatObservedAt","updatedAt") ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET "lifecycleState"='active',"claimEnabled"=true,"declaredCapacity"=EXCLUDED."declaredCapacity","effectiveCapacity"=EXCLUDED."effectiveCapacity","supportedJobTypes"=canonical_types,"registryVersion"=registry_version,"registryFingerprint"=registry_fingerprint,"generation"=next_generation,"lifecycleVersion"=0,"startedObservedAt"=observed_at,"heartbeatObservedAt"=observed_at,"drainingStartedAt"=NULL,"shutdownObservedAt"=NULL,"updatedAt"=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;RETURN bigint,total_capacity bigint,observed_at timestamptz,predicate_bitmap jsonb,secondary_reasons text[]) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE a bigint;d bigint;sh bigint;st bigint;inc bigint;cap bigint;total bigint;missing_family bigint;family_capacity bigint;bits jsonb;primary_reason text;primary_state text;secondary text[];now_at timestamptz:=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;BEGIN SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE fresh AND compatible AND "lifecycleState"='active'),count(*) FILTER(WHERE fresh AND compatible AND "lifecycleState"='draining'),count(*) FILTER(WHERE fresh AND compatible AND "lifecycleState"='shutdown'),count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT fresh),count(*) FILTER(WHERE fresh AND NOT compatible),COALESCE(sum("effectiveCapacity") FILTER(WHERE fresh AND compatible AND "lifecycleState"='active' AND "claimEnabled"),0),count(*) INTO a,d,sh,st,inc,cap,total FROM (SELECT *,"heartbeatObservedAt">now_at-interval '2 minutes' fresh,("registryVersion"='async-job-registry.v2' AND "registryFingerprint"='a456065e5ee6ea13812c457dc21ef53efff26ee0a7f49dd964e4f547077a9e74' AND "supportedJobTypes"=ARRAY['analytics.release.seal','analytics.source.cleanup']) compatible FROM public.worker_heartbeats WHERE "lifecycleState" IS NOT NULL)x;SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.f1_readiness_principal_job_capacity c WHERE c."principalRole"=required.principal_role AND required.job_type=ANY(c."supportedJobTypes") AND c."registryVersion"='async-job-registry.v2' AND c."registryFingerprint"='a456065e5ee6ea13812c457dc21ef53efff26ee0a7f49dd964e4f547077a9e74' AND c."observedAt">now_at-interval '15 seconds' AND c."claimEnabled" AND c."capacity">0)) INTO missing_family FROM (VALUES('vanstro_worker_runtime','analytics.release.seal'),('vanstro_worker_runtime','analytics.source.cleanup'),('vanstro_signer_admin_runtime','security.signer.manage'),('vanstro_kms_rotation_runtime','analytics.subject-key.rotate'),('vanstro_dsar_runtime','privacy.subject.purge')) required(principal_role,job_type);SELECT COALESCE(sum(c."capacity"),0) INTO family_capacity FROM public.f1_readiness_principal_job_capacity c WHERE c."registryVersion"='async-job-registry.v2' AND c."registryFingerprint"='a456065e5ee6ea13812c457dc21ef53efff26ee0a7f49dd964e4f547077a9e74' AND c."observedAt">now_at-interval '15 seconds' AND c."claimEnabled" AND c."capacity">0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES('vanstro_worker_runtime','analytics.release.seal'),('vanstro_worker_runtime','analytics.source.cleanup'),('vanstro_signer_admin_runtime','security.signer.manage'),('vanstro_kms_rotation_runtime','analytics.subject-key.rotate'),('vanstro_dsar_runtime','privacy.subject.purge')) required(principal_role,job_type) WHERE required.principal_role=c."principalRole" AND required.job_type=ANY(c."supportedJobTypes"));bits:=jsonb_build_object('migration_incompatible',NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.f1_readiness_health_source WHERE "sourceKey"='migration' AND healthy AND "observedAt">now_at-interval '15 seconds'),'database_unavailable',NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.f1_readiness_health_source WHERE "sourceKey"='database' AND healthy AND "observedAt">now_at-interval '15 seconds'),'registry_incompatible',inc>0,'no_worker_observed',total=0,'all_workers_stale',total>0 AND st=total,'all_workers_shutdown',total>0 AND sh=total,'all_workers_draining',total>0 AND d+sh=total AND d>0,'zero_claim_capacity',cap=0 OR missing_family>0,'required_storage_unavailable',NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.f1_readiness_health_source WHERE "sourceKey"='storage' AND healthy AND "observedAt">now_at-interval '30 seconds'),'required_parser_unavailable',NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.f1_readiness_health_source WHERE "sourceKey"='parser' AND healthy AND "observedAt">now_at-interval '30 seconds'),'optional_provider_degraded',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.f1_readiness_health_source WHERE "sourceKey"='optional_provider' AND NOT healthy AND "observedAt">now_at-interval '30 seconds'));SELECT reason,state INTO primary_reason,primary_state FROM (VALUES(1,'migration_incompatible','not_ready'),(2,'database_unavailable','not_ready'),(3,'registry_incompatible','not_ready'),(4,'no_worker_observed','not_ready'),(5,'all_workers_stale','stale'),(6,'all_workers_shutdown','not_ready'),(7,'all_workers_draining','not_ready'),(8,'zero_claim_capacity','not_ready'),(9,'required_storage_unavailable','not_ready'),(10,'required_parser_unavailable','not_ready'),(11,'optional_provider_degraded','degraded')) v(priority,reason,state) WHERE COALESCE((bits->>reason)::boolean,false) ORDER BY priority LIMIT 1;IF primary_reason IS NULL THEN primary_reason:='ready';primary_state:='ready';END IF;SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(reason ORDER BY priority) FILTER(WHERE reason<>primary_reason),ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO secondary FROM (VALUES(1,'migration_incompatible'),(2,'database_unavailable'),(3,'registry_incompatible'),(4,'no_worker_observed'),(5,'all_workers_stale'),(6,'all_workers_shutdown'),(7,'all_workers_draining'),(8,'zero_claim_capacity'),(9,'required_storage_unavailable'),(10,'required_parser_unavailable'),(11,'optional_provider_degraded')) v(priority,reason) WHERE COALESCE((bits->>reason)::boolean,false);RETURN QUERY SELECT primary_state,primary_reason,a,st,family_capacity,now_at,bits,secondary;END $fn$;

sqlFunctionBodies.canonicalSql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.p10_reject_event_mutation_v1() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE jid uuid;owner_value text;revision_value integer;BEGIN IF TG_OP='DELETE' AND current_user='vanstro_p10_guard_owner' THEN BEGIN jid:=current_setting('app.p10_cleanup_job_id',true)::uuid;owner_value:=current_setting('app.p10_cleanup_lease_owner',true);revision_value:=current_setting('app.p10_cleanup_lease_revision',true)::integer;EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN jid:=NULL;END;IF jid IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_temp.p10_authorized_delete_event_ids x WHERE x."eventId"=OLD.id AND x."jobId"=jid AND x."leaseOwner"=owner_value AND x."leaseRevision"=revision_value) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.async_jobs j WHERE j.id=jid AND j."jobType" IN('analytics.source.cleanup','privacy.subject.purge') AND j.status='running' AND j."leaseOwner"=owner_value AND j."leaseRevision"=revision_value AND j."leaseExpiresAt">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND j."attemptDeadline">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND j."cancellationRequestedAt" IS NULL) THEN RETURN OLD;END IF;END IF;RAISE EXCEPTION 'ANALYTICS_FOUNDATION_EVENT_IMMUTABLE';END $fn$;

sqlFunctionBodies.canonicalSql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.p10_has_authenticated_consent_v1(digest bytea,kid text,epoch text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ SELECT COALESCE((SELECT e.action IN ('granted','updated') AND COALESCE((e.preferences->>'analytics')::boolean,false) FROM public.privacy_consent_events e WHERE e."authorityVersion"=2 AND e."authenticatedSubjectDigest"=digest AND e."subjectKeyVersion"=kid AND e."identityRealmVersion"='vanstro.authenticated-user.v1' AND e."identityEpoch"=epoch AND e."consentSchemaVersion"='vanstro.analytics.authenticated-consent.v1' ORDER BY e."createdAt" DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT 1),false) $fn$;

sqlFunctionBodies.canonicalSql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.p10_get_release_day_v2(session_token_hash text,scope_fingerprint text,release_day date,metric_definition_version text,identity_epoch text,suppression_policy_version text,field_visibility_profile text,expected_context_revision text,expected_target_revision bigint) RETURNS TABLE(release_day_out date,status text,completeness text,cells jsonb) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE a record; BEGIN SELECT * INTO a FROM public.p02_resolve_persisted_authority_v3(session_token_hash,'p10_release_family',scope_fingerprint||'|'||release_day::text||'|'||metric_definition_version||'|'||identity_epoch||'|'||suppression_policy_version||'|'||field_visibility_profile,'read','analytics.release.read',expected_context_revision,expected_target_revision); IF a.outcome<>'authorized' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'P10_RELEASE_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; RETURN QUERY SELECT x."releaseDay",x.status,x.completeness,COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('cellKey',c."cellKey",'state',c.state,'valueKind',c."valueKind",'publishedValue',c."publishedValue") ORDER BY c."cellKey") FILTER(WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.analytics_foundation_release x LEFT JOIN public.analytics_foundation_release_cell c ON c."releaseId"=x.id WHERE x."scopeFingerprint"=scope_fingerprint AND x."releaseDay"=release_day AND x."metricDefinitionVersion"=metric_definition_version AND x."identityEpoch"=identity_epoch AND x."suppressionPolicyVersion"=suppression_policy_version AND x."fieldVisibilityProfile"=field_visibility_profile GROUP BY x.id; END $fn$;

sqlFunctionBodies.canonicalSql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.p10_ingest_event_v5(session_token_hash text,resource_id text,expected_context_revision text,expected_target_revision bigint,event_id uuid,occurred_at timestamptz,dimensions jsonb,idempotency_hash text,request_id text,subject_digest bytea,subject_kid text,subject_epoch text,assertion_expires_at timestamptz,assertion_nonce text,assertion_signer_id text,assertion_signature bytea) RETURNS TABLE(fact_id uuid,success_audit_event_id uuid,outcome text) LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE a record;digest bytea:=subject_digest;kid text:=subject_kid;epoch text:=subject_epoch;aid uuid;intent_hash text;post_seal boolean;claim public.f1_p10_idempotency%ROWTYPE;BEGIN SELECT * INTO a FROM public.p02_resolve_persisted_authority_v3(session_token_hash,'p10_analytics_ingestion',resource_id,'ingest','analytics.ingest',expected_context_revision,expected_target_revision);IF a.outcome<>'authorized' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'P10_INGEST_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;intent_hash:=encode(digest(convert_to(event_id::text||'|'||resource_id||'|'||extract(epoch from occurred_at)::bigint::text||'|'||dimensions::text||'|'||encode(subject_digest,'hex')||'|'||kid||'|'||epoch||'|analytics.ingest|'||expected_context_revision||'|'||expected_target_revision||'|'||assertion_signer_id||'|'||assertion_nonce||'|'||request_id,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(encode(digest,'hex'),0));IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.f1_subject_erasure_tombstone t WHERE t."erasureToken"=public.vanstro_subject_erasure_token_v1(convert_to('vanstro.subject-erasure.v1','UTF8')||digest)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUBJECT_ERASED';END IF;SELECT * INTO claim FROM public.f1_p10_idempotency WHERE "operation"='ingest' AND "idempotencyHash"=idempotency_hash FOR UPDATE;IF FOUND THEN IF claim."intentHash"<>intent_hash THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT' USING ERRCODE='23505';END IF;IF claim.state='completed' THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT claim."resultId",claim."auditEventId",'replay'::text;RETURN;END IF;END IF;PERFORM * FROM public.p10_verify_subject_assertion_v1(session_token_hash,'analytics.ingest',idempotency_hash,intent_hash,digest,kid,epoch,assertion_expires_at,assertion_nonce,assertion_signer_id,assertion_signature);IF NOT public.p10_validate_subject_digest_v3(digest,kid,epoch,'ingest') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'P10_SUBJECT_DIGEST_INVALID';END IF;IF NOT public.p10_has_authenticated_consent_v1(digest,kid,epoch) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'P10_CONSENT_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;IF idempotency_hash!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'P10_HASH_INVALID';END IF;INSERT INTO public.f1_p10_idempotency("operation","idempotencyHash","intentHash","subjectDigest","expiresAt") VALUES('ingest',idempotency_hash,intent_hash,subject_digest,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+interval '30 days') ON CONFLICT("operation","idempotencyHash") DO NOTHING;UPDATE public.f1_p10_idempotency SET "subjectDigest"=digest WHERE "operation"='ingest' AND "idempotencyHash"=idempotency_hash AND "subjectDigest" IS NULL;SELECT * INTO claim FROM public.f1_p10_idempotency WHERE "operation"='ingest' AND "idempotencyHash"=idempotency_hash FOR UPDATE;IF claim."intentHash"<>intent_hash THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT' USING ERRCODE='23505';END IF;IF claim.state='completed' THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT claim."resultId",claim."auditEventId",'replay'::text;RETURN;END IF;PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended((occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date::text||'|metric.v1|'||epoch||'|suppression.k3.v1|safe|'||repeat('0',64),0));SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.analytics_foundation_release r WHERE r."scopeFingerprint"=repeat('0',64) AND r."releaseDay"=(occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AND r."metricDefinitionVersion"='metric.v1' AND r."identityEpoch"=epoch AND r."suppressionPolicyVersion"='suppression.k3.v1' AND r."fieldVisibilityProfile"='safe') INTO post_seal;aid:=public.p04_write_forward_audit_v4(session_token_hash,'p10_analytics_ingestion',resource_id,'ingest','analytics.ingest',expected_context_revision,expected_target_revision,'create','analytics_event','succeeded',NULL,request_id,jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion','audit-metadata.v1','entries',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','eventType','value','foundation.analytics.observed.v1'))));INSERT INTO public.analytics_foundation_event(id,"eventName","eventVersion","schemaVersion","schemaFingerprint",producer,source,"occurredAt","observedAt","ingestedAt","subjectClass","subjectDigest","authenticatedSubjectDigest","subjectKeyVersion","identityEpoch","contextRevision","authorizationScopeKind","dealerIds","locationIds","scopeFingerprint","fieldVisibilityFingerprint","resourceType","resourceId",dimensions,"idempotencyKeyHash","eventIntentHash","occurrenceIdentity",sequence,provenance,"consentClass","consentVersion",late,"expiresAt","authorityVersion","postSealLate","successAuditEventId") VALUES(event_id,'foundation.analytics.observed.v1','analytics-event-schema.v1','analytics-event-schema.v1',repeat('0',64),'dashboard_admin','dashboard_api',occurred_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'admin_user',encode(digest,'hex'),digest,kid,epoch,'f1-v15-clarification','global',ARRAY[]::text[],ARRAY[]::text[],repeat('0',64),repeat('0',64),'foundation_sample',resource_id,dimensions,idempotency_hash,intent_hash,request_id,0,'p10-owned-conformance','analytics','vanstro.analytics.authenticated-consent.v1',post_seal,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+interval '30 days',2,post_seal,aid);UPDATE public.f1_p10_idempotency SET state='completed',"resultId"=event_id,"auditEventId"=aid WHERE "operation"='ingest' AND "idempotencyHash"=idempotency_hash;UPDATE public.f1_verified_nonce SET "resultId"=event_id WHERE "idempotencyHash"=idempotency_hash AND "intentHash"=intent_hash;RETURN QUERY SELECT event_id,aid,'created'::text;END $fn$;

sqlFunctionBodies.canonicalSql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.p10_seal_release_day_v2(job_id uuid,lease_owner text,lease_revision integer,retry_generation integer,generation_attempt integer,release_day date,identity_epoch text,request_id text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE job public.async_jobs%ROWTYPE; rid uuid:=gen_random_uuid();aid uuid;den bigint;num bigint;comp bigint;state text;epoch text;cutoff timestamptz:=(release_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')+interval '1 day 10 minutes';BEGIN SELECT * INTO STRICT job FROM public.async_jobs j WHERE j.id=p10_seal_release_day_v2.job_id AND j."jobType"='analytics.release.seal' AND j."jobTypeVersion"='analytics.release.seal.v1' AND j."payloadSchemaVersion"='analytics-release-seal-input.v1' AND j."resultSchemaVersion"='analytics-release-seal-result.v1' AND j.status='running' AND j."leaseOwner"=p10_seal_release_day_v2.lease_owner AND j."leaseRevision"=p10_seal_release_day_v2.lease_revision AND j."retryGeneration"=p10_seal_release_day_v2.retry_generation AND j."generationAttempt"=p10_seal_release_day_v2.generation_attempt AND j."leaseExpiresAt">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND j."attemptDeadline">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND j."cancellationRequestedAt" IS NULL AND j."payload"->>'releaseDay'=release_day::text AND j."payload"->>'identityEpoch'=identity_epoch FOR SHARE;PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(release_day::text||'|metric.v1|'||identity_epoch||'|suppression.k3.v1|safe|'||repeat('0',64),0));SELECT id INTO rid FROM public.analytics_foundation_release WHERE "scopeFingerprint"=repeat('0',64) AND "releaseDay"=release_day AND "metricDefinitionVersion"='metric.v1' AND "identityEpoch"=identity_epoch AND "suppressionPolicyVersion"='suppression.k3.v1' AND "fieldVisibilityProfile"='safe';IF FOUND THEN RETURN rid;END IF;rid:=gen_random_uuid();IF CURRENT_TIMESTAMP<cutoff THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'P10_PREMATURE_SEAL';END IF; SELECT min("identityEpoch") INTO epoch FROM public.analytics_foundation_event WHERE "authorityVersion"=2 AND "occurredAt">=release_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AND "occurredAt"<release_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'+interval '1 day' AND "ingestedAt"<=cutoff;IF epoch IS NULL THEN epoch:=identity_epoch;ELSIF epoch<>identity_epoch THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'P10_REQUESTED_EPOCH_MISMATCH';END IF;IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.analytics_foundation_event WHERE "authorityVersion"=2 AND "occurredAt">=release_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AND "occurredAt"<release_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'+interval '1 day' AND "ingestedAt"<=cutoff AND "identityEpoch"<>epoch) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'P10_CROSS_EPOCH_FORBIDDEN';END IF;WITH clipped AS (SELECT DISTINCT "authenticatedSubjectDigest",dimensions->>'category' category FROM public.analytics_foundation_event e WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.f1_subject_erasure_tombstone t WHERE t."erasureToken"=digest(convert_to('vanstro.subject-erasure.v1','UTF8')||e."authenticatedSubjectDigest",'sha256')) AND "authorityVersion"=2 AND "identityEpoch"=epoch AND "occurredAt">=release_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AND "occurredAt"<release_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'+interval '1 day' AND "ingestedAt"<=cutoff) SELECT count(DISTINCT c."authenticatedSubjectDigest") FILTER(WHERE category='view'),count(DISTINCT c."authenticatedSubjectDigest") FILTER(WHERE c.category='engage' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clipped v WHERE v."authenticatedSubjectDigest"=c."authenticatedSubjectDigest" AND v.category='view')) INTO den,num FROM clipped c;comp:=GREATEST(den-num,0);state:=CASE WHEN den=0 AND num=0 AND comp=0 THEN 'empty' WHEN den IN(1,2) OR num IN(1,2) OR comp IN(1,2) THEN 'suppressed' ELSE 'published' END;aid:=public.p04_write_system_job_audit_v1(job_id,lease_owner,lease_revision,'create','analytics_release',release_day::text,'succeeded',NULL,request_id,jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion','audit-metadata.v1','entries',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','releaseDay','value',release_day::text))));INSERT INTO public.analytics_foundation_release VALUES(rid,repeat('0',64),release_day,'metric.v1',epoch,'suppression.k3.v1','safe','global',state,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.analytics_foundation_event WHERE "occurredAt">=release_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AND "occurredAt"<release_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'+interval '1 day' AND "ingestedAt">cutoff) THEN 'late_excluded' ELSE 'sealed' END,cutoff,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,(SELECT count(*) FROM public.analytics_foundation_event WHERE "occurredAt">=release_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AND "occurredAt"<release_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'+interval '1 day' AND "ingestedAt">cutoff),2,aid);INSERT INTO public.analytics_foundation_release_event SELECT rid,id FROM public.analytics_foundation_event WHERE "authorityVersion"=2 AND "identityEpoch"=epoch AND "occurredAt">=release_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AND "occurredAt"<release_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'+interval '1 day' AND "ingestedAt"<=cutoff;INSERT INTO public.analytics_foundation_release_cell("id","releaseId","cellKey",state,"valueKind","denominatorDistinct","numeratorDistinct","complementDistinct","publishedValue",completeness) SELECT gen_random_uuid(),rid,k,state,CASE WHEN k='rate' THEN 'rate' ELSE 'count' END,CASE WHEN state='published' THEN den WHEN state='empty' THEN 0 END,CASE WHEN state='published' THEN num WHEN state='empty' THEN 0 END,CASE WHEN state='published' THEN comp WHEN state='empty' THEN 0 END,CASE WHEN state='published' THEN CASE k WHEN 'view' THEN den::numeric WHEN 'engage' THEN num::numeric WHEN 'denominator' THEN den::numeric WHEN 'numerator' THEN num::numeric WHEN 'complement' THEN comp::numeric WHEN 'rate' THEN num::numeric/NULLIF(den,0) END END,'sealed' FROM unnest(ARRAY['view','engage','denominator','numerator','complement','rate']) k;RETURN rid;END $fn$;
sqlFunctionBodies.name: p10_seal_release_day_v2

sqlFunctionBodies.canonicalSql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.p10_cleanup_source_events_v2(job_id uuid,lease_owner text,lease_revision integer,retry_generation integer,generation_attempt integer,through_release_day date,row_limit integer,request_id text) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE job public.async_jobs%ROWTYPE; n integer;aid uuid;BEGIN SELECT * INTO STRICT job FROM public.async_jobs j WHERE j.id=p10_cleanup_source_events_v2.job_id AND j."jobType"='analytics.source.cleanup' AND j."jobTypeVersion"='analytics.source.cleanup.v1' AND j."payloadSchemaVersion"='analytics-source-cleanup-input.v1' AND j."resultSchemaVersion"='analytics-source-cleanup-result.v1' AND j.status='running' AND j."leaseOwner"=p10_cleanup_source_events_v2.lease_owner AND j."leaseRevision"=p10_cleanup_source_events_v2.lease_revision AND j."retryGeneration"=p10_cleanup_source_events_v2.retry_generation AND j."generationAttempt"=p10_cleanup_source_events_v2.generation_attempt AND j."leaseExpiresAt">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND j."attemptDeadline">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND j."cancellationRequestedAt" IS NULL AND j."payload"->>'throughReleaseDay'=through_release_day::text AND (j."payload"->>'rowLimit')::integer=row_limit FOR SHARE; IF row_limit<1 OR row_limit>10000 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.analytics_foundation_release r WHERE r."releaseDay"=through_release_day AND r."scopeFingerprint"=job."payload"->>'scopeFingerprint' AND r."metricDefinitionVersion"=job."payload"->>'metricDefinitionVersion' AND r."identityEpoch"=job."payload"->>'identityEpoch' AND r."suppressionPolicyVersion"=job."payload"->>'suppressionPolicyVersion' AND r."fieldVisibilityProfile"=job."payload"->>'fieldVisibilityProfile' AND r."status" IN('empty','suppressed','published')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'P10_CLEANUP_NOT_SEALED';END IF;PERFORM set_config('app.p10_cleanup_job_id',job_id::text,true);PERFORM set_config('app.p10_cleanup_lease_owner',lease_owner,true);PERFORM set_config('app.p10_cleanup_lease_revision',lease_revision::text,true);CREATE TEMP TABLE IF NOT EXISTS p10_authorized_delete_event_ids("eventId" uuid PRIMARY KEY,"jobId" uuid NOT NULL,"leaseOwner" text NOT NULL,"leaseRevision" integer NOT NULL) ON COMMIT DROP;GRANT SELECT ON pg_temp.p10_authorized_delete_event_ids TO vanstro_p10_guard_owner;TRUNCATE pg_temp.p10_authorized_delete_event_ids;WITH exact_release AS (SELECT r.id FROM public.analytics_foundation_release r WHERE r."releaseDay"<=through_release_day AND r."scopeFingerprint"=job."payload"->>'scopeFingerprint' AND r."metricDefinitionVersion"=job."payload"->>'metricDefinitionVersion' AND r."identityEpoch"=job."payload"->>'identityEpoch' AND r."suppressionPolicyVersion"=job."payload"->>'suppressionPolicyVersion' AND r."fieldVisibilityProfile"=job."payload"->>'fieldVisibilityProfile'),doomed AS (SELECT e.id FROM public.analytics_foundation_event e JOIN public.analytics_foundation_release_event l ON l."eventId"=e.id JOIN exact_release r ON r.id=l."releaseId" WHERE e."expiresAt"<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY e."expiresAt" LIMIT row_limit FOR UPDATE OF e SKIP LOCKED),authorized AS (INSERT INTO p10_authorized_delete_event_ids SELECT id,job_id,lease_owner,lease_revision FROM doomed RETURNING "eventId"),deleted_ledger AS (DELETE FROM public.analytics_foundation_release_event l USING p10_authorized_delete_event_ids d WHERE l."eventId"=d."eventId" RETURNING l."eventId"),deleted AS (DELETE FROM public.analytics_foundation_event e USING p10_authorized_delete_event_ids d WHERE e.id=d."eventId" RETURNING e.id) SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM deleted;aid:=public.p04_write_system_job_audit_v1(job_id,lease_owner,lease_revision,'delete','analytics_event',through_release_day::text,'succeeded','completed',request_id,jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion','audit-metadata.v1','entries',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','deletedCount','value',n))));RETURN n;END $fn$;

sqlFunctionBodies.canonicalSql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.f1_consume_no_old_instances_v2(rollout_id text,environment_name text,expected_manifest_digest text) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE expected_count integer;consumed_count integer;telemetry_count integer;BEGIN IF rollout_id IS NULL OR environment_name IS NULL OR expected_manifest_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ATTESTATION_ARGUMENT_INVALID';END IF;PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('vanstro-f1-migration70-contract:'||rollout_id,0));IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.f1_deployment_attestation_consumption WHERE "rolloutId"=rollout_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ATTESTATION_REPLAY';END IF;SELECT count(*) INTO expected_count FROM public.f1_deployment_expected_instance e WHERE e."rolloutId"=rollout_id AND e.environment=environment_name AND e."expectedManifestDigest"=expected_manifest_digest;IF expected_count=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ATTESTATION_EXPECTED_SET_EMPTY';END IF;CREATE TEMP TABLE eligible_attestation ON COMMIT DROP AS SELECT a.* FROM public.f1_deployment_instance_attestation a JOIN public.f1_deployment_expected_instance e ON e."rolloutId"=a."rolloutId" AND e."instanceId"=a."instanceId" AND e.environment=a.environment WHERE a."rolloutId"=rollout_id AND a.environment=environment_name AND a."observedAt">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-interval '2 minutes' AND a."observedAt"<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+interval '5 seconds' AND a."codeVersion"=e."expectedCodeVersion" AND a."schemaCompatibility"=e."expectedSchemaCompatibility" AND a."attestationDigest"=expected_manifest_digest AND NOT a.draining AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.f1_trusted_ed25519_signer s WHERE s."signerId"=a."signerId" AND s.purpose='deployment_attestation' AND s.active AND s."notBefore"<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND s."notAfter">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND public.vanstro_verify_ed25519_v1(int4send(octet_length(convert_to('vanstro.deployment-attestation.v1','UTF8')))||convert_to('vanstro.deployment-attestation.v1','UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(a."rolloutId",'UTF8')))||convert_to(a."rolloutId",'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(a.environment,'UTF8')))||convert_to(a.environment,'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(a."instanceId",'UTF8')))||convert_to(a."instanceId",'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(a."codeVersion",'UTF8')))||convert_to(a."codeVersion",'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(a."schemaCompatibility"::text,'UTF8')))||convert_to(a."schemaCompatibility"::text,'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(a."attestationDigest",'UTF8')))||convert_to(a."attestationDigest",'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(extract(epoch from a."observedAt")::bigint::text,'UTF8')))||convert_to(extract(epoch from a."observedAt")::bigint::text,'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(a.draining::text,'UTF8')))||convert_to(a.draining::text,'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(a.nonce,'UTF8')))||convert_to(a.nonce,'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(a."attestedBy",'UTF8')))||convert_to(a."attestedBy",'UTF8'),a.signature,s."publicKey")) AND a."observedAt"=(SELECT max(x."observedAt") FROM public.f1_deployment_instance_attestation x WHERE x."rolloutId"=a."rolloutId" AND x."instanceId"=a."instanceId");GET DIAGNOSTICS consumed_count=ROW_COUNT;PERFORM 1 FROM public.f1_deployment_instance_attestation a JOIN eligible_attestation e ON e."rolloutId"=a."rolloutId" AND e."instanceId"=a."instanceId" AND e."observedAt"=a."observedAt" FOR UPDATE;IF consumed_count=0 OR consumed_count<>expected_count OR EXISTS(SELECT "instanceId" FROM public.f1_deployment_expected_instance WHERE "rolloutId"=rollout_id AND environment=environment_name AND "expectedManifestDigest"=expected_manifest_digest EXCEPT SELECT "instanceId" FROM eligible_attestation) OR EXISTS(SELECT "instanceId" FROM eligible_attestation EXCEPT SELECT "instanceId" FROM public.f1_deployment_expected_instance WHERE "rolloutId"=rollout_id AND environment=environment_name AND "expectedManifestDigest"=expected_manifest_digest) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ATTESTATION_ELIGIBLE_SET_MISMATCH';END IF;SELECT count(*) INTO telemetry_count FROM public.f1_old_call_report r JOIN public.f1_old_function_call_telemetry t ON t."reportId"=r."reportId" JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t."functionOid" WHERE r."rolloutId"=rollout_id AND r.environment=environment_name AND r."manifestDigest"=expected_manifest_digest AND r."windowEndedAt">r."windowStartedAt" AND r."windowEndedAt"<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+interval '5 seconds' AND r."consumedAt" IS NULL AND t."identitySignature"='public.'||p.proname||'('||pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)||')';IF telemetry_count<>31 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.f1_old_function_call_telemetry t JOIN public.f1_old_call_report r ON r."reportId"=t."reportId" WHERE r."rolloutId"=rollout_id AND t."callCount">0) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OLD_FUNCTION_CALLS_REMAIN';END IF;IF (SELECT count(DISTINCT a."instanceId") FROM public.f1_deployment_instance_attestation a WHERE a."rolloutId"=rollout_id AND a.environment=environment_name AND a."observedAt">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-interval '2 minutes' AND a."observedAt"<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+interval '5 seconds')<>expected_count OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.f1_deployment_instance_attestation a WHERE a.environment=environment_name AND a."codeVersion"='old68' AND a."observedAt">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-interval '10 minutes') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ATTESTATION_SET_MISMATCH';END IF;WITH deleted AS (DELETE FROM public.f1_deployment_instance_attestation a USING eligible_attestation e WHERE a."rolloutId"=e."rolloutId" AND a."instanceId"=e."instanceId" AND a."observedAt"=e."observedAt" RETURNING *) SELECT count(*) INTO consumed_count FROM deleted;IF consumed_count<>expected_count THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ATTESTATION_CONSUME_MISMATCH';END IF;PERFORM public.f1_consume_old_call_report_v1(rollout_id);INSERT INTO public.f1_deployment_attestation_consumption VALUES(rollout_id,environment_name,expected_manifest_digest,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,consumed_count);RETURN consumed_count;END $fn$;

IF;intent_hash:=encode(digest(convert_to(encode(subject_digest,'hex')||'|'||kid||'|'||epoch||'|consent.write|'||expected_context_revision||'|'||expected_target_revision||'|'||assertion_signer_id||'|'||assertion_nonce||'|'||request_id||'|'||consent_action,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');PERFORM public.f1_p10_idempotency WHERE "operation"='consent' AND "idempotencyHash"=idempotency_hash FOR UPDATE;IF FOUND THEN IF claim."intentHash"<>intent_hash THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT' bytea,kid text,epoch text,expires_at timestamptz,nonce text,signer_id text,signature bytea) RETURNS TABLE(actor_id text,digest bytea,verified_kid text,verified_epoch text) LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE uid text;sid text;pubkey bytea;payload bytea;BEGIN SELECT s."userId",s.id INTO uid,sid FROM public.refresh_sessions s JOIN public.users u ON u.id=s."userId" WHERE s."tokenHash"=session_token_hash AND s."revokedAt" IS NULL AND s."expiresAt">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND u.status='active';IF uid IS NULL OR expires_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP OR expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+interval '5 minutes' OR nonce!~'^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22,128}$' OR octet_length(subject_digest)<>32 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUBJECT_ASSERTION_INVALID';END IF;payload:=int4send(octet_length(convert_to('vanstro.subject-assertion.v1','UTF8')))||convert_to('vanstro.subject-assertion.v1','UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(uid,'UTF8')))||convert_to(uid,'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(sid,'UTF8')))||convert_to(sid,'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(encode(digest(session_token_hash,'sha256'),'hex'),'UTF8')))||convert_to(encode(digest(session_token_hash,'sha256'),'hex'),'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(kid,'UTF8')))||convert_to(kid,'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(epoch,'UTF8')))||convert_to(epoch,'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(operation_key,'UTF8')))||convert_to(operation_key,'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(extract(epoch from expires_at)::bigint::text,'UTF8')))||convert_to(extract(epoch from expires_at)::bigint::text,'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(nonce,'UTF8')))||convert_to(nonce,'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(encode(subject_digest,'hex'),'UTF8')))||convert_to(encode(subject_digest,'hex'),'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(idempotency_hash,'UTF8')))||convert_to(idempotency_hash,'UTF8')||int4send(octet_length(convert_to(intent_hash,'UTF8')))||convert_to(intent_hash,'UTF8');IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.f1_trusted_ed25519_signer s WHERE s."signerId"=signer_id AND s.purpose='kms_hmac_subject_assertion' AND s.active AND s."notBefore"<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND s."notAfter">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND public.vanstro_verify_ed25519_v1(payload,signature,s."publicKey")) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUBJECT_ASSERTION_SIGNATURE_INVALID';END IF;INSERT INTO public.f1_verified_nonce("purpose",nonce,operation,"idempotencyHash","intentHash","subjectDigest","expiresAt","consumedAt") VALUES('subject_assertion',nonce,operation_key,idempotency_hash,intent_hash,subject_digest,expires_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);RETURN QUERY SELECT uid,subject_digest,kid,epoch;EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUBJECT_ASSERTION_REPLAY';END $fn$;

integer,expected_current_kid text,new_kid text,new_provider_ref text,request_id text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE VALUES(new_kid,new_provider_ref,'vanstro.analytics.subject-epoch.v1:'||new_kid,'active',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);aid:=public.p04_write_system_job_audit_v1(job_id,lease_owner,lease_revision,'update','runtime_config',new_kid,'succeeded','completed',request_id,jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion','audit-metadata.v1','entries',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','previousKid','value',current_key.kid),jsonb_build_object('key','newKid','value',new_kid))));RETURN integer,operation text,signer_id text,public_key bytea,purpose text,not_before timestamptz,not_after timestamptz,request_id text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE aid uuid;BEGIN PERFORM 1 FROM public.async_jobs j WHERE j.id=job_id AND j."jobType"='security.signer.manage' AND j."jobTypeVersion"='security.signer.manage.v1' AND j."payloadSchemaVersion"='security-signer-manage-input.v1' AND j."resultSchemaVersion"='security-signer-manage-result.v1' AND j.status='running' AND j."leaseOwner"=lease_owner AND j."leaseRevision"=lease_revision AND j."retryGeneration"=retry_generation AND j."generationAttempt"=generation_attempt AND j."leaseExpiresAt">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND j."attemptDeadline">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND j."cancellationRequestedAt" IS NULL AND j.payload->>'operation'=operation AND j.payload->>'signerId'=signer_id AND j.payload->>'publicKeyHash'=encode(digest(public_key,'sha256'),'hex') AND j.payload->>'purpose'=purpose AND (j.payload->>'notBefore')::timestamptz=not_before AND (j.payload->>'notAfter')::timestamptz=not_after AND j.payload->>'requestId'=request_id FOR SHARE;IF NOT FOUND OR operation NOT IN('bootstrap','rotate','revoke') OR purpose NOT IN('kms_hmac_subject_assertion','deployment_attestation','old_call_telemetry') OR octet_length(public_key)<>32 OR not_after<=not_before THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SIGNER_MANAGEMENT_INVALID';END IF;IF operation='revoke' THEN UPDATE public.f1_trusted_ed25519_signer SET active=false,"notAfter"=LEAST("notAfter",CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE "signerId"=signer_id;IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SIGNER_NOT_FOUND';END IF;ELSE IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.f1_trusted_ed25519_signer s WHERE s."signerId"=signer_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SIGNER_HISTORY_IMMUTABLE';END IF;INSERT INTO IF;aid:=public.p04_write_system_job_audit_v1(job_id,lease_owner,lease_revision,'update','runtime_config',signer_id,'succeeded','completed',request_id,jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion','audit-metadata.v1','entries',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','signerOperation','value',operation),jsonb_build_object('key','purpose','value',purpose))));RETURN integer,subject_digest bytea,retention_cutoff timestamptz,request_id text) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE n integer:=0;x integer;aid uuid;erasure_token bytea;prior public.f1_subject_erasure_tombstone%ROWTYPE;intent_hash text;BEGIN PERFORM 1 FROM public.async_jobs j WHERE j.id=job_id AND j."jobType"='privacy.subject.purge' AND j."jobTypeVersion"='privacy.subject.purge.v1' AND j."payloadSchemaVersion"='privacy-subject-purge-input.v1' AND j."resultSchemaVersion"='privacy-subject-purge-result.v1' AND j.status='running' AND j."leaseOwner"=lease_owner AND j."leaseRevision"=lease_revision AND j."retryGeneration"=retry_generation AND j."generationAttempt"=generation_attempt AND j."leaseExpiresAt">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND j."attemptDeadline">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND j."cancellationRequestedAt" IS NULL AND j.payload->>'subjectDigestHex'=encode(subject_digest,'hex') AND (j.payload->>'retentionCutoff')::timestamptz=retention_cutoff AND j.payload->>'requestId'=request_id FOR SHARE;IF NOT FOUND OR retention_cutoff>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-interval '30 days' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DSAR_PURGE_NOT_ELIGIBLE';END IF;PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(encode(subject_digest,'hex'),0));erasure_token:=public.vanstro_subject_erasure_token_v1(convert_to('vanstro.subject-erasure.v1','UTF8')||subject_digest);intent_hash:=encode(digest(convert_to(encode(erasure_token,'hex')||'|'||job_id::text||'|'||request_id||'|'||extract(epoch from retention_cutoff)::bigint::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');SELECT * INTO prior FROM public.f1_subject_erasure_tombstone WHERE "erasureToken"=erasure_token AND "retentionCutoff"=retention_cutoff;IF FOUND THEN IF prior."intentHash"<>intent_hash OR prior."jobId"<>job_id OR prior."requestId"<>request_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DSAR_REPLAY_CONFLICT';END IF;RETURN prior."purgedRows";END IF;DELETE FROM public.f1_verified_nonce WHERE "subjectDigest"=subject_digest AND "expiresAt"<=retention_cutoff;GET DIAGNOSTICS x=ROW_COUNT;n:=n+x;DELETE FROM public.f1_p10_consent_command WHERE "subjectDigest"=subject_digest AND "expiresAt"<=retention_cutoff;GET DIAGNOSTICS x=ROW_COUNT;n:=n+x;PERFORM set_config('app.p10_cleanup_job_id',job_id::text,true);PERFORM set_config('app.p10_cleanup_lease_owner',lease_owner,true);PERFORM set_config('app.p10_cleanup_lease_revision',lease_revision::text,true);CREATE TEMP TABLE IF NOT EXISTS p10_authorized_delete_event_ids("eventId" uuid PRIMARY KEY,"jobId" uuid NOT NULL,"leaseOwner" text NOT NULL,"leaseRevision" integer NOT NULL) ON COMMIT DROP;GRANT SELECT ON pg_temp.p10_authorized_delete_event_ids TO vanstro_p10_guard_owner;TRUNCATE pg_temp.p10_authorized_delete_event_ids;INSERT INTO p10_authorized_delete_event_ids SELECT e.id,job_id,lease_owner,lease_revision FROM public.analytics_foundation_event e WHERE e."authenticatedSubjectDigest"=subject_digest AND e."expiresAt"<=retention_cutoff;DELETE FROM public.analytics_foundation_release_event l USING public.analytics_foundation_event e WHERE l."eventId"=e.id AND e."authenticatedSubjectDigest"=subject_digest AND e."expiresAt"<=retention_cutoff;GET DIAGNOSTICS x=ROW_COUNT;n:=n+x;DELETE FROM public.analytics_foundation_event WHERE "authenticatedSubjectDigest"=subject_digest AND "expiresAt"<=retention_cutoff;GET DIAGNOSTICS x=ROW_COUNT;n:=n+x;DELETE FROM public.privacy_consent_events WHERE "authenticatedSubjectDigest"=subject_digest AND "createdAt"<=retention_cutoff;GET DIAGNOSTICS x=ROW_COUNT;n:=n+x;DELETE FROM public.f1_p10_idempotency WHERE "subjectDigest"=subject_digest AND "expiresAt"<=retention_cutoff;GET DIAGNOSTICS x=ROW_COUNT;n:=n+x;aid:=public.p04_write_system_job_audit_v1(job_id,lease_owner,lease_revision,'delete','analytics_event',encode(erasure_token,'hex'),'succeeded','completed',request_id,jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion','audit-metadata.v1','entries',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','purgedRows','value',n))));INSERT INTO public.f1_subject_erasure_tombstone("erasureToken","retentionCutoff","intentHash","jobId","requestId","purgedRows","auditEventId","erasedAt") VALUES(erasure_token,retention_cutoff,intent_hash,job_id,request_id,n,aid,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);RETURN n;END $fn$;

sqlFunctionBodies.canonicalSql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.f1_ingest_signed_old_call_report_v1(report_id uuid,rollout_id text,environment_name text,manifest_digest text,window_started_at timestamptz,window_ended_at timestamptz,collector_nonce text,collector_signer_id text,rows_value jsonb,signature bytea) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE payload bytea;report_digest bytea;inserted integer;BEGIN IF jsonb_typeof(rows_value)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(rows_value)<>31 OR window_ended_at<=window_started_at OR window_ended_at<window_started_at+interval '10 minutes' OR window_ended_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+interval '5 seconds' OR window_ended_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-interval '2 minutes' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TELEMETRY_REPORT_INVALID';END IF;report_digest:=digest(convert_to(rows_value::text,'UTF8'),'sha256');payload:=int4send(length(convert_to('vanstro.old-call-report.v1','UTF8')))||convert_to('vanstro.old-call-report.v1','UTF8')||int4send(length(convert_to(report_id::text,'UTF8')))||convert_to(report_id::text,'UTF8')||int4send(length(convert_to(rollout_id,'UTF8')))||convert_to(rollout_id,'UTF8')||int4send(length(convert_to(environment_name,'UTF8')))||convert_to(environment_name,'UTF8')||int4send(length(convert_to(manifest_digest,'UTF8')))||convert_to(manifest_digest,'UTF8')||int4send(length(convert_to(extract(epoch from window_started_at)::bigint::text,'UTF8')))||convert_to(extract(epoch from window_started_at)::bigint::text,'UTF8')||int4send(length(convert_to(extract(epoch from window_ended_at)::bigint::text,'UTF8')))||convert_to(extract(epoch from window_ended_at)::bigint::text,'UTF8')||int4send(length(convert_to(collector_nonce,'UTF8')))||convert_to(collector_nonce,'UTF8')||int4send(length(convert_to(collector_signer_id,'UTF8')))||convert_to(collector_signer_id,'UTF8')||int4send(length(convert_to(encode(report_digest,'hex'),'UTF8')))||convert_to(encode(report_digest,'hex'),'UTF8');IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.f1_trusted_ed25519_signer s WHERE s."signerId"=collector_signer_id AND s.purpose='old_call_telemetry' AND s.active AND s."notBefore"<=window_started_at AND s."notAfter">=window_ended_at AND public.vanstro_verify_ed25519_v1(payload,signature,s."publicKey")) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TELEMETRY_SIGNATURE_INVALID';END IF;INSERT INTO public.f1_old_call_report VALUES(report_id,rollout_id,environment_name,manifest_digest,window_started_at,window_ended_at,collector_nonce,collector_signer_id,report_digest,signature,NULL);INSERT INTO public.f1_old_function_call_telemetry SELECT report_id,rollout_id,x."functionOid"::oid,x."identitySignature",x."callCount",x."lastCalledAt" FROM jsonb_to_recordset(rows_value)x("functionOid" bigint,"identitySignature" text,"callCount" bigint,"lastCalledAt" timestamptz);GET DIAGNOSTICS inserted=ROW_COUNT;IF inserted<>31 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.f1_old_function_call_telemetry t WHERE t."lastCalledAt">window_ended_at)) OR t."callCount"<0)) OR EXISTS(SELECT "functionOid","identitySignature" FROM public.f1_old_function_registry EXCEPT SELECT "functionOid","identitySignature" FROM public.f1_old_function_call_telemetry WHERE "reportId"=report_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT "functionOid","identitySignature" FROM public.f1_old_function_call_telemetry WHERE "reportId"=report_id EXCEPT SELECT "functionOid","identitySignature" FROM public.f1_old_function_registry) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TELEMETRY_ROW_COUNT';END IF;RETURN inserted;END $fn$;

sqlFunctionBodies.canonicalSql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.p09_report_principal_job_capacity_v1(principal_role text,pool_instance text,incarnation_id text,supported_job_types text[],registry_version text,registry_fingerprint text,capacity integer,claim_enabled boolean,observed_at timestamptz,expected_generation bigint) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE allowed boolean;current_generation bigint;next_generation bigint;canonical_types text[];BEGIN canonical_types:=CASE principal_role WHEN 'vanstro_worker_runtime' THEN ARRAY['analytics.release.seal','analytics.source.cleanup'] WHEN 'vanstro_signer_admin_runtime' THEN ARRAY['security.signer.manage'] WHEN 'vanstro_kms_rotation_runtime' THEN ARRAY['analytics.subject-key.rotate'] WHEN 'vanstro_dsar_runtime' THEN ARRAY['privacy.subject.purge'] ELSE NULL END;allowed:=CASE principal_role WHEN 'vanstro_worker_runtime' THEN pg_has_role(session_user,'vanstro_worker_lifecycle_cap','MEMBER') WHEN 'vanstro_signer_admin_runtime' THEN pg_has_role(session_user,'vanstro_p10_signer_admin_cap','MEMBER') WHEN 'vanstro_kms_rotation_runtime' THEN pg_has_role(session_user,'vanstro_p10_kms_rotation_cap','MEMBER') WHEN 'vanstro_dsar_runtime' THEN pg_has_role(session_user,'vanstro_p10_dsar_cap','MEMBER') ELSE false END;IF NOT allowed OR session_user<>principal_role OR supported_job_types<>canonical_types OR registry_version<>'async-job-registry.v2' OR registry_fingerprint<>'a456065e5ee6ea13812c457dc21ef53efff26ee0a7f49dd964e4f547077a9e74' OR capacity<0 OR expected_generation<1 OR observed_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-interval '5 seconds' OR observed_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+interval '5 seconds' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRINCIPAL_CAPACITY_REPORT_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;SELECT "generation" INTO current_generation FROM public.f1_readiness_principal_job_capacity WHERE "principalRole"=principal_role AND "poolInstance"=pool_instance AND "incarnationId"=incarnation_id FOR UPDATE;IF NOT FOUND OR current_generation<>expected_generation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRINCIPAL_CAPACITY_STALE';END IF;next_generation:=current_generation+1;UPDATE public.f1_readiness_principal_job_capacity SET "capacity"=p09_report_principal_job_capacity_v1.capacity,"claimEnabled"=claim_enabled,"observedAt"=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,"generation"=next_generation WHERE "principalRole"=principal_role AND "poolInstance"=pool_instance AND "incarnationId"=incarnation_id AND "generation"=current_generation;IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRINCIPAL_CAPACITY_STALE';END IF;RETURN next_generation;END $fn$;
sqlFunctionBodies.name: p09_report_principal_job_capacity_v1

sqlFunctionBodies.canonicalSql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.p09_claim_principal_capacity_pool_v1(principal_role text,supported_job_types text[],registry_version text,registry_fingerprint text,capacity integer,claim_enabled boolean,observed_at timestamptz) RETURNS TABLE(pool_instance text,incarnation_id text,generation bigint) LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$ DECLARE allowed boolean;canonical_types text[];pool_value text;incarnation_value text;BEGIN canonical_types:=CASE principal_role WHEN 'vanstro_worker_runtime' THEN ARRAY['analytics.release.seal','analytics.source.cleanup'] WHEN 'vanstro_signer_admin_runtime' THEN ARRAY['security.signer.manage'] WHEN 'vanstro_kms_rotation_runtime' THEN ARRAY['analytics.subject-key.rotate'] WHEN 'vanstro_dsar_runtime' THEN ARRAY['privacy.subject.purge'] ELSE NULL END;allowed:=CASE principal_role WHEN 'vanstro_worker_runtime' THEN pg_has_role(session_user,'vanstro_worker_lifecycle_cap','MEMBER') WHEN 'vanstro_signer_admin_runtime' THEN pg_has_role(session_user,'vanstro_p10_signer_admin_cap','MEMBER') WHEN 'vanstro_kms_rotation_runtime' THEN pg_has_role(session_user,'vanstro_p10_kms_rotation_cap','MEMBER') WHEN 'vanstro_dsar_runtime' THEN pg_has_role(session_user,'vanstro_p10_dsar_cap','MEMBER') ELSE false END;IF NOT allowed OR session_user<>principal_role OR supported_job_types<>canonical_types OR registry_version<>'async-job-registry.v2' OR registry_fingerprint<>'a456065e5ee6ea13812c457dc21ef53efff26ee0a7f49dd964e4f547077a9e74' OR capacity<0 OR observed_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-interval '5 seconds' OR observed_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+interval '5 seconds' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRINCIPAL_CAPACITY_CLAIM_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;DELETE FROM public.f1_readiness_principal_job_capacity WHERE "observedAt"<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-interval '2 minutes';pool_value:=principal_role||':pool:'||gen_random_uuid()::text;incarnation_value:=principal_role||':incarnation:'||gen_random_uuid()::text;INSERT INTO public.f1_readiness_principal_job_capacity VALUES(principal_role,pool_value,incarnation_value,canonical_types,registry_version,registry_fingerprint,capacity,claim_enabled,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,1);RETURN QUERY SELECT pool_value,incarnation_value,1::bigint;END $fn$;
